title: 机器人空翻，腿怎么飞了？
title_en: Why Did the Robot's Leg Fly Off?

segments.zh: 一台一米八的机器人空翻落地，
segments.en: A 1.8-meter robot lands a flip,
and one of its legs flies off.
The leg: I'm out.
The robot: wait for me!
This was Unitree's H2-X on October 22,

segments.zh: 在自家发布会上的表演。
segments.en: live at the company's own launch event.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：机器人那么硬，
segments.en: Today's question: robots are so tough,
so how does a leg just fall off?
Meet Flip,

segments.zh: 一个热爱空翻的小机器人。
segments.en: a little robot who loves flips.
Reportedly, the H2-X is about 1.82 meters tall
and weighs about 70 kilos.

segments.zh: 宣传片里，它从4米高台翻下来，
segments.en: In its promo video, it flips off a 4-meter platform
and sticks the landing.

segments.zh: 可现场这一次，侧空翻转到一半，
segments.en: But live on stage, halfway through a side flip,
it lost its balance.

segments.zh: 落地没站稳，右边小腿从关节处脱落，
segments.en: It landed badly, and the right lower leg came off at the joint
and slid across the mat.
Lesson one: once you leave the ground,
your spin is locked in.
There's nothing to push on in midair.
That's conservation of angular momentum.

segments.zh: 就像花样滑冰：手一收转得快，
segments.en: Like a figure skater: arms in, faster.
Arms out, slower.
But the total spin
is handed in at takeoff, like an exam.
A tiny error at takeoff
becomes a big tilt at landing.

segments.zh: 我们估算：侧空翻在空中大约只有半秒，
segments.en: Our estimate: a side flip is airborne for about half a second.
Barely any time to fix it.

segments.zh: 再烧一点：猫从空中掉下，
segments.en: Even weirder: a falling cat
can still turn itself over in midair.

segments.zh: 它先扭前半身、再扭后半身，
segments.en: It twists its front half, then its back half.

segments.zh: 总转动一直是零，照样翻过来。
segments.en: Total spin stays zero, and it still flips over.
Robots can learn that trick too,
but half a second is tight.

segments.zh: 第二个道理：落地那一下，
segments.en: Lesson two: how hard
is the landing?

segments.zh: 我们估算：从半米高落下，
segments.en: Our estimate: falling half a meter,
you hit the ground at about 3 meters a second.

segments.zh: 如果膝盖弯一弯，用30厘米慢慢停，
segments.en: Bend the knees and stop over 30 centimeters:
the force is about 2.7 times body weight.

segments.zh: 如果腿绷直，只用5厘米就停住，
segments.en: Lock the legs and stop in 5 centimeters:
11 times body weight!
For a 70-kilo robot,

segments.zh: 一条腿要扛七百多公斤的力。
segments.en: one leg takes the force of over 700 kilos.
That's why we bend our knees:
stretch the time, shrink the force.
When you run, each step pushes on the ground
with about two to three times your weight.
Gymnasts land with knees, ankles and hips

segments.zh: 膝盖、脚踝、髋部一起当弹簧。
segments.en: all working as springs.
Lesson three, the weirdest:
legs don't mind squeezing. They hate bending.

segments.zh: 就像一根筷子：顺着压很难压断，
segments.en: Like a chopstick: push along it, it holds.
Bend it sideways, snap.

segments.zh: 我们推测：姿态一歪，力从侧面来，
segments.en: Our guess: with the body tilted, the force comes sideways,

segments.zh: 整条腿就成了被横掰的筷子。
segments.en: and the leg becomes a bent chopstick.
And the first thing to give
is usually a seam, like a joint.

segments.zh: 据报道，它腿部关节扭矩大约360牛米，
segments.en: Reportedly its leg joints make about 360 newton-meters,
enough to kick in a car door.

segments.zh: 可力气大不等于扛得住：
segments.en: But strong isn't the same as tough:
gears and bolts all have limits.

segments.zh: 机器人腿里，电机就是肌肉，
segments.en: In a robot leg, the motors are the muscles.

segments.zh: 落地时要像弹簧一样往回收。
segments.en: On landing they have to give, like springs.

segments.zh: 要是这一刻控制没算准，
segments.en: If the control gets that moment wrong,
the motors push back stiff.

segments.zh: 工程上还有一招：故意留个保险丝，
segments.en: Engineers also have a trick: a built-in fuse.

segments.zh: 先坏便宜的零件，保住贵的。
segments.en: A cheap part breaks first to save the expensive ones.

segments.zh: 这次是故障还是保护设计？
segments.en: Was this a failure, or a safety feature?

segments.zh: 截至报道，宇树还没有回应。
segments.en: As of the reports, Unitree hasn't said.

segments.zh: 友情提示：官方原因还没公布，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: no official cause yet.

segments.zh: 今天讲的是我们按物理做的推测。
segments.en: Today's story is our physics-based guess.
A robot falling isn't shameful.

segments.zh: 每一跤，工程师都能学到东西。
segments.en: Every fall teaches the engineers something.
Studies find toddlers learning to walk
fall more than ten times an hour.
So don't laugh at Flip.
It's just paying tuition.

segments.zh: 下次再空翻，记得：屈膝、站稳，
segments.en: Next flip, remember: bend, land, stay together.
Legs, don't leave first.
